description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - Imposing Entertainment Tax at Kadugannawa Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the imposition of an entertainment tax by the Kadugannawa Urban Council. It is based on the powers granted by the Entertainment Tax Ordinance (a specific law) and involves the creation of a regulatory requirement (a 10% tax). The content is primarily about establishing a legal/regulatory framework for taxation, not about government personnel changes, organisational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
